## What happened

Change notice CHG-0131 records the implementation of Camera firmware 4.2.0 at Market Eye Clinic from 2023-05-10. The change concerns the firmware used by the camera system at the site. This notice provides a concise record of the change and its operational significance.

## Cause

The recorded cause of the change is Supplier patch. The patch was applied as part of the supplier’s maintenance activity and resulted in the firmware change identified in this notice.

## Effect

Following the change, Ungradable rate rises at the site. This may affect the proportion of images that can be assessed and may require the local service team to monitor image quality and operational impact. Any concerns about the change should be raised through the usual service desk route, quoting CHG-0131.
